statement: (p k : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hk : 0 < k) : (1 : ℕ) ≠ p ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have h_p_ge_two : 2 ≤ p := by
    have h := hp.two_le
    exact h
  
  have h_k_ge_one : 1 ≤ k := by
    omega
  
  have h_one_lt_pow : 1 < p ^ k := by
    have h₁ : 1 < p := by
      linarith [h_p_ge_two]
    have h₂ : 1 < p ^ k := by
      apply Nat.one_lt_pow (by omega)
      <;> omega
    exact h₂
  
  have h_main : (1 : ℕ) ≠ p ^ k := by
    intro h
    have h₁ : 1 < p ^ k := h_one_lt_pow
    linarith
  
  exact h_main
